title: Greedy Bruhat chains dominate supports of dual Schubert polynomials
author: An, Serena; Tung, Katherine; Zhang, Yuchong
work: Newton polytopes of dual Schubert polynomials

primary_locator.additional_local_core: complete exact Bruhat saturated/greedy-chain, dominant pairing, global weight and support definitions, greedy-chain existence/product and all inversion-pairing induction cases

difficulty_reason: The core establishes a dominant pairing between every saturated-chain transposition multiset and the inversion set, together with the exact greedy-chain product. The resulting support equality is a nonroutine Bruhat-order structural argument; all induction cases and constructions are retained.
